premeasurement_fixture_revision: many-replacements fixed to 32 secret leaves + 1 clean leaf before any Linux run; 400-leaf draft was not measured; independent accuracy work observed conservative whole-leaf masking on high leaf counts, so stress results remain separate from comparable-work timing
order: condition cyclic rotations, reversing the second full cycle; 14 measured rounds for seven conditions (six defaults plus optional fused); exact condition order in each raw sample
installation: pinned bootstrap fresh/refresh 12 balanced repetitions including archive/checksum network; predownloaded bootstrap script itself excluded and its one-off download recorded; dependencies already installed; archive extraction measured separately
rss: wait4 max child RSS KiB; separate rss-profile has process RSS sum sampled every 5ms; profile elapsed/CPU excluded from performance comparisons
audit_state: off or on-warm: fresh HOME for each version/mode/host/audit/input/concurrency. One warmup initializes state; 14 measured rounds retain that same HOME and audit/cache files. Different inputs and concurrency never share state. Separate RSS profile uses a distinct HOME with its own warmup. No claim that every cache lookup hits: exact cache files preserved; TTL expiration is possible.
scope: public standalone archives only; fixed official scanner/config; audit off and on-warm; no aggregate input-weighted score
